title: UTPro Dashboard Report: Summer Moderates Construction, But PreCon Still Growing
summary:
As the summer gets alternately hot or smoky enough to shut down outdoor events, new data from UTPro shows that new construction has grown at a slower rate than filing paperwork for new proposals. Overall, development continues to increase in the Greater Golden Horseshoe. 

Our UTPro Public Dashboard provides a snapshot of development activity in the Greater Golden Horseshoe at any given time. Each month, we highlight a snippet of what's going on: the scale of planned development, what’s actively being built, and how much residential vs. non-residential space is underway.
